name: OpenRouter account balance
summary: Account balance in USD. Needs an OpenRouter Management key.
description: Needs an OpenRouter Management key. A Management key cannot call models, but it is account-wide and unscoped: it can create, change and delete API keys and manage account administration across all workspaces. NeKode only sends one documented GET /api/v1/credits request per poll and stores the key encrypted. Create a dedicated key with an expiration date. This adapter is optional; an ordinary API key cannot read the account balance.

errorActions.auth: The OpenRouter Management key was rejected (it may be expired or revoked). Create a new one, enter it and save.
errorActions.config: Enter an OpenRouter Management key, not an ordinary API key, then save. See the OpenRouter usage guide.

configSchema.label: OpenRouter Management key
configSchema.description: Write-only. Create it under Management API Keys in OpenRouter; an ordinary API key is refused.
